name: qbr-renewal
description: Generate a fresh owned-products QBR PowerPoint through the website and prepare a source-backed conversation brief when requested.

interface.shortDescription: Customer QBRs and clear renewal preparation
interface.longDescription: One plugin generates a fresh QBR Express PowerPoint, delivers the file, and offers a one-page CSM conversation brief: value already realised, YoY and peer context, focus areas, product-linked next value moves, and discovery questions. Renewal-preparation requests include the brief automatically. No default Drive upload, Slides conversion, QBR MCP, bridge or Local Delivery plugin is required. Google Drive and Z2 support recommendation research.
defaultPrompt: Create a fresh QBR PowerPoint for this customer using owned products only.
Prepare a QBR PowerPoint and one-page conversation brief for this customer's renewal.
Prepare a renewal brief from this QBR without another deck.
